text: 【央行：二季度末不含个人住房贷款的消费性贷款余额20.83万亿元 同比下降1.7%】央行发布2026年二季度金融机构贷款投向统计报告，2026年二季度末，不含个人住房贷款的消费性贷款余额20.83万亿元，同比下降1.7%，上半年减少3400亿元。
text_en: [PBOC: At end-Q2 2026, consumer loans excluding personal housing loans were 20.83 trillion yuan, down 1.7% year-on-year] The PBOC released Q2 2026 financial institution loan allocation report: at end-Q2 2026, consumer loans excluding personal housing loans were 20.83 trillion yuan, down 1.7% year-on-year, with a decrease of 340 billion yuan in H1.
